blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — At least 63 houses were totally destroyed and seven others partially damaged after a fire swept through Sitio Lawis in Barangay Alaska Mambaling, Cebu City, on Sunday evening, November 1, affecting 128 families or 513 individuals.
